currentManifest.title: 我が国の建築は世界一ぃ！ ～DROP TOWER～
currentManifest.subtitle: もう1個だけ、積みたい。
core_mechanic: opposite overhang pairs with physical balance recovery
currentManifest.secondary_score: separate PERFECT combo and disjoint physical art-pair bonus
currentManifest.escalation_mechanic: Once accepted height strictly exceeds 15m, choose ordinary construction or irreversible fictional C mode: hanging swing 200%, future PERFECT bonus 300%.
currentManifest.risk_reward: Central precision remains stable; committed full-width overhangs can earn art points only when opposite placement improves support margin or foundation COM bias. C swing speed2× and future PERFECT/art basis3× once.
currentManifest.visual_identity: illustrated full-rectangle building floors, low city, quiet sky and architectural crane ledger
currentManifest.save_compatibility: Legacy best/bestBonus retained and displayed as old rules. Current floor/bonus records use rules2 keys; practice isolated.
